'''Sulan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as part of the [[Mantellian Army|Mantellian army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during part of the war, where he fought against the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] in the [[Separatist War]].

==Biography==
Sulan was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Mantellian Army|Mantellian army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the Republic. During the war he held the rank of [[Communications officer/Legends|Communications Officer]] and was deployed on the Republic held [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EGPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> Whilst stationed on the planet he and all Republic forces aided the corrupt local government in fighting the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]].<ref name="TOR" />

While stationed at Fort Garnik, Sulan believed he'd manage to shut down the hacking attempts into the Republic communications by Separatists. He was unaware however that hacking had in fact continued from the nearby [[Talloran village]] where a pair of data hubs had been built.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
A [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after he believed he'd put a stop to the Separatist hacking attempts Sulan was visited by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound]] and a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|member]] of [[Havoc Squad]] who informed him that they had destroyed the data hubs and put an end to the Separatist hacking. Sulan was shocked to discover that hacking had continued and thanked the pair by rewarding them with commendations before red-flagging all recent communications as possibly compromised.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
Whilst at Fort Garnik Sulan wore [[blue]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] including a helmet with four ammo pockets on the chest and a pair of beige pants with knee [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sulan is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. It is impossible for players of the Imperial faction to interact with Sulan as there is currently no way Imperial characters can travel to Ord Mantell.<ref name="TOR" />
